7323.about: In a bright bedroom in the morning, a young woman in a long light-blue shirt and socks laughs as she flings a white sheet high into the air over a wooden bed, and a ginger cat leaps through the air under the billowing sheet. The sheet settles over the bed with the cat sitting on top, and she leans over the bed and smooths the sheet around the cat. A bearded man in a bathrobe stands in the doorway holding mugs and drinking, and a pillow lies on the floor by tall windows and potted plants.
7323.question: What is the woman doing?

7324.about: On a snowy office rooftop between tall glass towers, a young man in a white shirt, tie and sunglasses, trousers rolled up, leans back in a striped deckchair in the one narrow beam of sunshine, his bare feet in a small inflatable paddling pool, holding an ice cream cone and enjoying the sun. Colleagues in winter coats and scarves stand behind him laughing, some filming with their phones. A pigeon sits on the snowy ledge beside an air-conditioning unit.

phrases.en: to film him on her phone
to perch on a snowy ledge

7324.question: What is the barefoot man doing?
7324.answer: He is making the most of the sun.

7325.about: At night on a beach under a full moon, a young woman with long curly hair, in a cream cable-knit sweater and denim shorts, stands behind a crackling campfire holding up a piece of driftwood, flinging her arms wide and leaning forward with her mouth open as she tells a dramatic story. Sparks fly into the dark. Friends listen around the fire: a young woman wrapped in a blanket stares wide-eyed, someone holds a marshmallow on a stick and a scruffy dog barks up at her. A guitar and an enamel mug lie in the sand.

phrases.en: to wave a piece of driftwood

7325.question: What is the standing woman doing?
7325.answer: She is telling a dramatic story.

7327.about: In a snowy old market street, a large male red deer with huge branching antlers stands on top of a wooden fruit cart full of red apples, bellowing, while apples tumble over the icy cobblestones. A smaller female deer without antlers stands on the left. The male jumps down from the cart and walks straight towards the viewer among the scattered apples, bellowing again. Market stalls with torn striped awnings line the stone houses, and men in winter coats run behind with a barking dog.

phrases.en: to stand next to the cart

7327.question: What is the male deer doing?
7327.answer: It is jumping off a cart.

7328.about: On a wide gravel promenade in a park, lined on both sides by tall autumn plane trees and old lamp posts and leading to an ornate iron gate, a huge flock of sheep walks down the middle of the path towards the viewer, herded by a black-and-white collie and a man with a wooden staff. Joggers and walkers with coffee cups line the edges of the path, golden leaves drift down onto the sheep and the low sun shines through the trees.

phrases.en: to run with its tail up
to run in a pink top

7328.question: What is the dog doing?
7328.answer: The dog is running next to the sheep.

7329.about: At night at a rainy football stadium under floodlights, a young player in a red shirt, red socks and white shorts stands at the edge of the pitch by the advertising boards while a woman in a clear rain poncho and red scarf leans over the barrier, hugs him tightly and kisses his cheek, and he laughs. His teammates in red jog towards them, a photographer kneels on the grass, a steward in a yellow jacket stands by the boards, and golden streamers fly over packed stands of cheering fans.
7329.question: What is the woman doing?
7329.answer: She is leaning over the barrier.

7332.about: In a bright bicycle factory with tall windows, a young woman in a navy cap, grey T-shirt, work apron and gloves steadies the wheel of a bicycle hanging from an overhead assembly line, then works on it with a cordless drill and finally turns to the steel workbench in front of her. On the bench lie trays of bolts, a bike chain, a stack of black tyres and a brown saddle. Other workers work at benches behind her and rows of finished bicycles stand in a rack on the right.

phrases.en: to hang from the assembly line

7332.question: What is the woman doing?
7332.answer: She is operating a cordless drill.

7334.about: In a sunlit woodworking workshop, a young woman with long wavy hair, in a dark hoodie and leather apron, crouches on the sawdust-covered floor and smiles up as a blank skateboard deck of pale, smooth maple wood falls from the air. She catches it, holds it across her knee and runs her hand along its smooth surface. Stacks of thin light wooden sheets lean against the wall, blank decks hang on a wall rack and a press, a band saw and a workbench stand around her. A dog sleeps under the bench.
7334.question: What is the woman doing?
7334.answer: She is stroking the maple deck.

7336.about: In a marina at sunrise, with rows of white motor yachts and sailing boats with tall masts moored along wooden jetties, a muscular man in sunglasses and a white bathrobe kneels on a big pink inflatable flamingo, paddling with a wooden oar and balancing a tray of coffee cups and pastries. A small dog watches from the jetty, a couple in bathrobes stand on the jetty and an older man leans from the bow of a boat. Ripples spread on the calm golden water.
7336.question: What is the man in sunglasses doing?
7336.answer: He is paddling across the marina.

7337.about: On a misty green clifftop by the sea, a young woman in an orange rain jacket and a knitted orange headband kneels in the long grass and uses small pliers to fix a little tag onto the leg of a puffin she holds, while another puffin stands on top of her head. Then she stands up and throws the tagged puffin into the air, and it flies away over the cliff as the puffin on her head flaps its wings. An open tin of orange tags lies in the grass and a colleague in an orange jacket with a clipboard laughs.
7337.question: What is the kneeling woman doing?
7337.answer: She is holding a bird in her hands.

7338.about: In a flat, wet marsh at sunset, a young woman in a black long-sleeved wetsuit kneels on a paddle board and paddles along a narrow channel of still water between tall green and golden grasses, right through a flock of pink flamingos that wade and take off around her. More flamingos fly across the pink sky. A white horse grazes in the grassland, a wooden bird-watching tower stands on the horizon and the board is reflected in the water.
7338.question: What is the woman doing?
7338.answer: She is paddling through the marsh.

7339.about: Close up under the white wooden eave of an old building, small birds with glossy dark blue backs, white bellies, long pointed wings and forked tails fly around a cup-shaped mud nest. One bird hovers in front of the nest with an insect in its beak, lands at the nest and pushes its head inside, then flies off again, while other birds swoop past. A few loose white feathers drift in the air, the light is soft and golden, and a blurred field lies in the background.
7339.question: What is the martin doing?
7339.answer: It is carrying an insect to its nest.

7340.about: On the high outer bridge of a cargo ship in a container port at dusk, a young woman officer with a blonde braid, in a navy uniform, leans over the rail pointing down and speaking into a walkie-talkie as she guides a red tugboat below. Behind her an older bearded captain in a white peaked cap watches calmly. Crew members in overalls handle ropes on the deck, a thermos flask and binoculars sit on the ledge, and cranes and stacked containers line the quay.
7340.question: What is the woman doing?
7340.answer: She is speaking into a walkie-talkie.

7342.about: In a dim art gallery, a tall wooden stand holds a thin, stretched, milky plastic sheet, lit from behind by a spotlight. A young woman with long platinum hair, in a long black dress, presses against the sheet from behind with her palms raised and her eyes closed, and pushes her face further into it, so that the thin sheet stretches and wrinkles around her hands and face. At the left a young man in the shadows covers his mouth in surprise. A floor light and coiled cables lie nearby.

phrases.en: to cover his mouth in shock

7342.question: What is the woman doing?
7342.answer: She is pushing her face into the membrane.

7344.about: On a busy city street between glass skyscrapers, a young woman bike courier in a sticker-covered helmet, a dark T-shirt, jeans and a messenger bag stops on her bicycle and hands a yellow envelope to a young man in a grey suit by a revolving door. He takes it and walks into the building, while she rides off along the pavement towards the viewer. A yellow taxi passes, steam rises from a street grate, pigeons peck on the pavement and office workers walk by.

phrases.target: the man in the grey suit

7344.question: What is the woman doing?
7344.answer: She is delivering an envelope to a man.

7345.about: On a snowy race track in the mountains, a young man in a red jacket over a white top, black ski trousers and sunglasses is pulled along on short skis by a rope tied around the middle of his body, at his waist, fastened to the harness of a brown horse galloping beside him. He laughs and shouts with his arms spread wide, wobbles and spreads them again. Spectators stand behind a rope line, another rider follows on a horse, and snowy pine trees and a wooden cabin with a smoking chimney fill the background.
7345.question: Where is the rope tied?
7345.answer: It is tied around his middle.

7347.about: A tall old stone mill building stands beside a river in evening light, with a big wooden waterwheel turning under rushing white water at its base. A young red-haired woman swings out from an upper doorway on a rope, sitting on a sack and laughing, and swings down over the waterwheel, while a cloud of white flour bursts from the loft door above her. Two men lean out of the doorway reaching towards her, a horse and cart stand on the left and birds fly over the roof.

phrases.en: to stand harnessed to a cart

7347.question: What is the woman doing?
7347.answer: She is swinging over the waterwheel.

7348.about: Inside an old windmill lit by oil lanterns, a young woman covered in white flour dust, in work clothes and boots, hangs from a thick rope above a wooden case holding two large round millstones and slides down it to the stone floor. A huge wooden cogwheel sits under the roof beams. A young man climbs a ladder and a woman at a shutter looks on, flour pours from a wooden chute into a sack, and full sacks stand on the floor.

phrases.en: to slide down a thick rope
to pour flour into a sack

7348.question: What is the flour-covered woman doing?
7348.answer: She is sliding down a thick rope.

7349.about: In the gravel courtyard of a large stone villa among vineyard hills, a man with slicked-back hair, an open cream silk shirt, gold chains, black trousers and loafers strides across a white towel laid over a puddle and keeps walking towards the viewer. Four young women in white blouses and black trousers follow him in a line, carrying expensive leather handbags, one holding a small dachshund in a bag. Classic silver sports cars are parked by a stone fountain, and tall cypress trees stand by the courtyard.

phrases.en: to lead a line of women

7349.question: What is the millionaire doing?
7349.answer: He is leading a line of women.

7352.about: A rainy outdoor fashion show on an airport apron at dusk. A young woman with short natural hair walks towards the camera down the wet runway in a black turtleneck, a very short flared orange skirt, black tights, knee-high black boots and a long black coat that swings as she moves. Guests sit on both sides, some under umbrellas, a large passenger plane stands behind them, floodlights and a lighting rig glow, confetti blows in the wind and a worker in a high-visibility jacket runs across under stormy orange clouds.

phrases.en: to stride down a wet runway

7352.question: What is the model doing?
7352.answer: She is striding down a wet runway.

7359.about: A small mountain railway station in falling snow at dusk. A young woman in a blue ski suit, a padded vest, a knitted hat and ski boots runs through the snow along the platform with skis and a pole in her arms, reaching out towards a red and cream train that keeps moving beside her. A conductor in a cap leans out of the open door and stretches out his hand, friends in ski gear wave from a window, and a porter with a luggage trolley stands by the lit wooden station hut.

phrases.en: to lean out of the doorway

7359.question: What is the woman doing?
7359.answer: She is chasing a moving train.

7362.about: A sunny country kitchen. A big silver stand mixer whips chocolate batter and cream in its large steel mixing bowl so fast that batter splashes out and flour hangs in the air. A beagle at the counter edge jumps up, catches a flying splash of cream in its mouth and then licks its lips. Broken eggshells and a raw yolk lie on the floury wooden counter with a wooden spoon, a pile of sugar, a kitchen timer and muffins on a cooling rack, an open recipe book stands behind the mixer and copper pans hang on the wall.

phrases.en: to catch a splash of cream

7362.question: What is the beagle doing?
7362.answer: It is catching a splash of cream.

7363.about: A rocky mountain summit under a deep blue sky. A young woman in a yellow jacket, black trousers and hiking boots climbs onto a boulder, stretches up and holds a mobile phone high in the air, first with one hand and then with both, her ponytail blowing sideways. A young man sits on the rocks below, laughing and eating a sandwich. A stone cairn, a backpack, trekking poles and a paper map lie on the rocks, two black birds fly past and hazy ridges stretch to the horizon.

phrases.en: to stand on a big rock

7363.question: What is the woman doing?
7363.answer: She is holding her phone above her head.

7364.about: A bright white gallery with a glass roof. A young man with curly hair in a paint-stained T-shirt and grey trousers stands on a stepladder and blows at a large red disc of a big hanging sculpture of thin black wires with red, yellow, black and white discs. The sculpture starts to turn slowly in the air while he raises his hands and watches it with a smile. A young woman in black holds the ladder and looks up, and two visitors watch from a balcony above.
7364.question: What is the mobile doing?
7364.answer: It is turning in the air.

7365.about: A bright car design studio. A young woman in a grey clay-stained work coat, with a smudge on her cheek, pulls a toothed tool along the side of a full-size clay car, and a long curl of brown clay peels off and falls. In the foreground a small clay model of the same car stands on a round metal turntable, and clay shavings cover the floor. A young man shapes clay at a trolley on the left, a photographer takes pictures in the background and long ceiling lights shine overhead.

phrases.en: to scrape clay off the car
to shape a lump of clay
to snap photos in the background

7365.question: What is the woman doing?
7365.answer: She is scraping clay off the car.

7367.about: A cosy living room in the evening. A young woman with dark curly hair in a cream knit sweater leans close to a lit aquarium and purses her lips like a fish. A black fish with a large sail-like fin and tail swims up to the glass until it is face to face with her. Smaller silver-white fish swim among green plants and driftwood, and food flakes float at the surface. A fish net and a tub of fish food lie on the cabinet, and a cat sleeps on the sofa behind her.

phrases.en: to show off its huge fin

7367.question: What is the woman doing?
7367.answer: She is pursing her lips like a fish.

7368.about: A warm hallway on a snowy night. A middle-aged woman in a burgundy cardigan and slippers holds a young man's face and kisses his cheek as he comes in through the open front door in a green parka, laughing. He drops his big canvas bag, they hug tightly and he lifts her a little off the floor, then she kisses his cheek again. A golden retriever jumps up at them, snow falls outside, a wooden sledge and scarves hang on the wall and a kitchen glows at the back.
7368.question: What is the woman doing?

7370.about: Sea kayaking in front of a glacier under a grey sky. A young man in a red helmet, a yellow jacket and a life vest faces the camera and paddles hard away from the glacier in a white sea kayak, his face strained, as a huge wall of blue ice breaks off behind him and crashes into the sea in a cloud of spray. Other kayakers in bright jackets sit in their kayaks further back, chunks of ice float on the choppy grey sea around him and seabirds circle overhead.

phrases.target: the man in the red helmet
the man in the red helmet

7370.question: What is the man in front doing?
7370.answer: He is paddling away from the glacier.

7372.about: A wooden treehouse in a rainforest during a rain shower. A young woman in a tank top, shorts and hiking boots stands on the small porch by the open door and pulls up a net bundle on a rope holding a cardboard box, a rolled sleeping mat, a potted plant and a bag, then lifts it onto the porch and turns towards the door. A monkey sits on the corrugated metal roof next to a lantern. A man on a platform below holds the other end of the rope, and huge tropical leaves surround the cabin.

phrases.en: to steady the rope from below

7372.question: What is the woman doing?
7372.answer: She is hoisting a heavy bundle onto the porch.

7373.about: Dusk at a narrow stone canal lock. A huge white cruise ship eases slowly forward into the lock, its bow only just fitting between the walls and pressing big black fenders against the sides while water churns at the hull. Crowds on the quay wave and take photos, workers in high-visibility jackets walk along the edge, passengers line the lit decks and strings of lights run up to the mast. A small stone lock-keeper's house with a lit window stands by the dark water.

phrases.en: to squeeze into a narrow lock
to wave at the huge ship

7373.question: What is the cruise ship doing?
7373.answer: It is squeezing into a narrow lock.

7376.about: Bright blue sea under water. A young woman in a black wetsuit, mask and long black fins swims forward through a clear tunnel that opens in the middle of a huge swirling school of small silver fish. Dolphins and sea lions glide along the edges of the shoal and cross the tunnel near her, trails of bubbles rise towards the surface, and the hull of a small boat floats on the sunlit surface high above. Rays of light shine down through the water.

phrases.en: to swim in a black wetsuit

7376.question: What is the woman doing?
7376.answer: She is gliding through a shoal of fish.

7377.about: A busy restaurant kitchen with white tiled walls and copper pans. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey trousers climbs a black iron spiral staircase and reaches up for a white chef's jacket that an older chef holds out to him from the gallery above. Cooks in white jackets and aprons cheer and push him upwards from below, and more cooks on the balcony throw tea towels into the air and clap. Steam rises from large steel pots on the stove.

phrases.en: to reach up for the jacket
to hold out a chef's jacket

7377.question: What is the young man doing?
7377.answer: He is climbing a spiral staircase.

7378.about: A wood-panelled courtroom in grey daylight. A middle-aged man in a navy suit and white shirt stands in the wooden dock behind a brass rail with a cold, blank face, his wrists in handcuffs, while a uniformed officer holds his arm. The view moves slowly closer to him. Behind him a woman in black bends over and cries into a dark coat. A woman lawyer in front lays her hand on a thick file next to a water jug, and rows of serious people watch under tall windows.
7378.question: What is the woman behind him doing?
7378.answer: She is sobbing into a dark coat.

7379.about: Inside a wooden barn at night, lit by old oil lanterns. A young man in a checked shirt, grey vest, braces and rolled trousers stands barefoot in front of the open barn door with his arms spread wide, telling a story. He leans forward with a wild face and then jumps up with both hands high in the air. A group of young friends sit on hay bales around him with mugs and plates, staring at him with open mouths, and a shaggy grey dog sits at his feet.
7379.question: What is the standing man doing?
7379.answer: He is spreading his arms wide.

7381.about: A snowy reindeer corral at pink winter dawn. A young woman with long fair braids, a dark blue knitted hat with a red patterned band, a black snowsuit and fur-trimmed boots strides through the snow and pulls a large reindeer along by a rope lasso. Many more reindeer with big antlers crowd behind her inside a wooden fence. Behind them stand a cone-shaped canvas tent with a fire glowing inside, a snowmobile, a person in orange and a line of bare birch trees.
7381.question: What is the young woman doing?
7381.answer: She is dragging a reindeer through the snow.

7382.about: A frozen lake at dusk in winter. A young woman in a red parka and red snow trousers kneels on the dark clear ice and screams with laughter as a flame from a small hole in the ice grows into a tall orange column of fire. White frozen gas bubbles are trapped in stacks inside the ice all around. Behind her two people in dark winter coats take photos, and a metal gas cylinder, a snowmobile and small wooden cabins stand along the snowy shore by the trees.
7382.question: What is the woman in red doing?
7382.answer: She is kneeling on the dark ice.

7383.about: A messy hotel room the morning after a party, with sunlight coming through white curtains. A young woman with red hair, a gold sequin dress and smudged make-up lies on the carpet and stretches her arm out towards a glass of water on a low table, grabs it and rolls onto her side holding it. A paper party hat lies next to her. Confetti, playing cards, banknotes, silver trays and bottles cover the floor, and a man in a white shirt and tie sleeps on the sofa behind her.
7383.question: What is the woman doing?
7383.answer: She is reaching for a glass of water.

7386.about: A wet street outside an old red-brick prison with towers and a huge arched wooden gate. A young man in a black bomber jacket, grey hoodie and black trousers walks out of the small open door carrying a plastic bag of belongings, shading his eyes against the daylight, then smiles. A uniformed guard stands in the doorway behind him. A friend in a dark jacket runs up the street from a parked car, and the two men hug tightly on the pavement.

phrases.en: to stand guard by the door

7386.question: Where is the guard standing?
7386.answer: He is standing in the doorway of the nick.

7387.about: A long family lunch outdoors under a vine-covered pergola by an old stone house on a sunny day. A bald older man in a light blue shirt leans over and pulls a coin from behind the ear of a young woman in a green sundress, who covers her eyes and laughs, holding a fork with a peach slice. He holds up the coin and she points at it, laughing. A grey-haired woman next to her laughs too. The linen table is full of grilled vegetables, peaches, bread and water carafes.
7387.question: What is the bald man doing?
7387.answer: He is pulling a coin from behind her ear.

7389.about: A roof being built high above an old town at sunset. A bearded carpenter in a white helmet, white shirt, black waistcoat and safety harness stands on a huge square beam of pale solid oak that hangs from a crane hook, and swings an axe into it so wood chips fly. The cut end shows its tree rings clearly. The beam then comes to rest on a wooden post. Below him young apprentices in black hold wooden mallets on the scaffolding next to rows of new rafters, and a church spire rises behind.
7389.question: What is the man cutting?
7389.answer: He is cutting the wood with an axe.

7392.about: A bright carpentry workshop seen from above. A young man in a grey long-sleeved top and a canvas apron rubs oil into a long pale wooden table with a cloth. One strip of the table is already dark, glossy and golden with oil. A ginger cat walks across the dry part of the table, lies down near its edge and then gets off the table, and the man looks up and grins. An open tin stands in a small puddle of oil next to a pair of cotton gloves, and another man works on a chair behind.
7392.question: What is the man in front doing?
7392.answer: He is oiling a long wooden table.

7393.about: A sunny olive grove. A young woman with long dark hair, a rust-coloured sleeveless top and a long cream skirt stands barefoot on a wooden crate and pours a thin golden-green stream of olive oil from a clay jug held high above her head. The oil lands on a round crusty loaf held up by a young man in a white linen shirt. She lowers the jug and he lifts the oily loaf to his face and smells it. Olives lie on a net on the ground, a donkey stands behind and pickers work among the trees.

phrases.en: to hold up a big jug

7393.question: What is the woman doing?
7393.answer: She is pouring olive oil on bread.

7394.about: A harbour on a foggy blue morning. A young woman in navy work overalls, gloves, boots and a knitted hat throws her whole weight against a long iron lever on the cobbled quay and pulls it down from upright to flat, smiling. The two halves of an old wooden drawbridge stand raised in the air, and a tall sailing ship slides through the gap. Behind a red and white barrier, cyclists, a bus, cars and people in hi-vis vests wait under lit street lamps.
7394.question: What is the woman doing?
7394.answer: She is heaving an iron lever.

7395.about: The sea between two towering dark cliffs. A young woman in a white helmet and navy jacket paddles a bright red kayak through the narrow gap between the rock walls and comes out towards the camera, smiling with excitement as white water foams around her. Grey seals lie on the rocks on both sides and watch her. Behind her another kayaker in yellow waits in the open water, and a lighthouse stands on a far headland in the hazy backlight.
7395.question: What is the woman doing?
7395.answer: She is paddling through a narrow opening.

7396.about: An abandoned funfair at dusk. An old merry-go-round lit up with hundreds of warm bulbs turns in a haze of mist, its painted wooden horses going round, although weeds and long grass grow all around it. A fox stands in the grass and watches, and the lights reflect in a rippled puddle on the cracked concrete. Behind it stand a broken ticket booth covered in ivy and a big Ferris wheel under a cloudy blue evening sky.

phrases.en: to watch from the long grass

7396.question: What is the fox doing?
7396.answer: The fox is watching the glowing merry-go-round.

7398.about: A record pressing factory. A young woman in a navy work coat and white cotton gloves lifts a large metal tape reel high above her head and looks up at it, then lowers it and holds it in front of her, looking at it and speaking, while a big crowd of workers watches from the back of the hall. Beside her a young man in ear defenders works a pressing machine. Black vinyl records run along a conveyor, tall stacks of white sleeves stand nearby, and an open tape case lies on a trolley.

phrases.en: to lift a tape reel overhead

7398.question: What is the woman in gloves doing?
7398.answer: She is lifting a tape reel above her head.

7401.about: A snowy mountain summit ridge at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds. A male climber in a red and black down suit, his beard covered in frost, kneels in the snow and breathes through a mask that a young woman in a yellow hooded down suit holds to his face, connected to an orange gas cylinder. Steam comes from the mask, then he stands up with the cylinder while she stays kneeling. A second orange cylinder lies in the snow, and other climbers walk up the slope below.
7401.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?
7401.answer: She is pressing an oxygen mask to his face.

7402.about: Inside a camper van parked in the desert. A young woman with her hair in a bun, a beige T-shirt and a head torch holds a small torch in her mouth and quickly stuffs a grey towel into a big backpack with a water bottle in its side pocket, then closes it, swings it onto her shoulder and stands up. A rolled sleeping mat lies next to her. A black and white dog comes in through the side door carrying a hiking boot, while outside a huge wall of sand blows closer.
7402.question: What is the woman doing?
7402.answer: She is packing a big bag.

7403.about: A sunny beach road. A young man in sunglasses, a linen shirt and shorts leans with one leg stretched out and pushes hard with both hands to slide shut the door of a pale blue vintage van crammed full with things and a pink inflatable flamingo. Surfboards, bags and folding chairs are piled high on the roof rack. The door closes and he stands up. On the sand three friends cheer with their arms up, one sitting on a cooler, and a beach ball, frisbee and towel lie on the road.

phrases.en: to force the van door shut
to stick out of the van

7403.question: What is the man in sunglasses doing?
7403.answer: He is forcing the van door shut.

7406.about: Looking up a narrow old street between tall ochre and pink houses with green wooden shutters and small iron balconies. A washing line stretched across the street holds a long row of women's underpants in soft pastel colours, lilac, pink, blue, mint, white and yellow, each pinned with pegs and swaying in the wind as they dry in the sun. The sky is pale and clear, and more houses continue down the lane.

phrases.en: to hang on a washing line

7406.question: What are the pants doing?
7406.answer: They are drying in the sun.

7407.about: A railway platform at night in the rain. A young woman with long dark hair in a camel coat and brown boots jumps into the arms of a man with glasses, a flat cap and a quilted navy jacket, and he lifts her and swings her round, both laughing. He sets her down, they hug and she touches his face. His suitcase stands next to them and a cloth bag lies on the ground with oranges and books. A smiling conductor leans out of the train door, and travellers with bags walk past.
7407.question: What is the woman doing?
7407.answer: She is embracing the man on the platform.

7408.about: Inside a warm, old-fashioned bar. A man with short brown hair and a cream linen shirt lifts a bulldog in a striped knitted jumper from the bar edge and sets it down carefully on a round wooden bar stool, where it stands calmly. He lets go, steps back and gestures towards the dog. A newspaper and a set of keys lie on the marble counter beside a brass rail. Shelves of bottles glow behind the bar, a bartender works in the background, and other customers talk further along.
7408.question: What is the man doing?
7408.answer: He is putting the dog on the stool.

7409.about: In front of a huge blue-white glacier wall. A woman with a knitted headband, a red jacket, leather work gloves and a climbing harness lifts a large chunk of clear blue ice broken off from the glacier up in front of her face, turns it, then lowers it to her chest and looks at the camera. The block is full of tiny air bubbles and drips water. Her breath steams in the cold air, and small floating pieces of ice and a black gravel shore lie behind her in bright sunlight.

phrases.en: to lift a chunk of ice

7409.question: What is the woman holding?
7409.answer: She is holding a large chunk of ice.

7410.about: A cold outdoor swimming race on a grassy riverbank. A young man in a black sleeveless swim top and shorts stands barefoot, pulls on a printed swim cap and goggles, then walks past a rope and steps into the brown river. A young woman beside him adjusts her goggles. A marshal in a yellow hi-vis vest holds up a clipboard next to a chalkboard of numbers, a crowd in winter coats stands behind a rope near piles of clothes and shoes, and a line of orange buoys floats on the water.
7410.question: What is the barefoot man doing?
7410.answer: He is wading into the river.

7411.about: A wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. An older judge in a black robe reads a paper at the high bench under a green lamp. At the tables in front, a young woman in a navy suit covers her mouth in shock while the woman beside her puts a hand on her back, then she stands up and turns to lean over the table towards that woman. On the other side a man in a grey suit holds his head in both hands. A clerk types on a laptop, files lie on the tables, and people watch from the benches.
7411.question: What is the man in grey doing?
7411.answer: He is clutching his head in his hands.

7412.about: A snowy mountain road under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a red puffer jacket and snow boots throws her fist in the air, shouts with joy and jumps next to a small white car with a red L sign on its roof, then leans in at the driver's window. Inside, a young man with glasses smiles from the driver's seat and holds up a clipboard with a big green tick. A man in an orange vest watches from a truck window, an orange snowplough waits behind, and a line of cars comes down the road.
7412.question: What is the woman doing?
7412.answer: She is jumping next to the car.

7415.about: A small, simple dockside cafe on a grey morning. A woman behind the counter pours tea from one white enamel mug into another next to a steel water urn, while bacon sizzles and steams on a griddle behind her. A bearded man in a brown work jacket and a yellow hi-vis vest steps up to the counter, picks up a pen and leans over a newspaper crossword. Mugs hang on hooks under a price board, another worker in a beanie waits behind, and cranes stand outside the window.
7415.question: What is the woman doing?
7415.answer: She is pouring tea into an enamel mug.

7416.about: A misty sea cliff covered in pink sea thrift flowers. A young woman with a long black braid, an olive waxed jacket and rubber boots stands on the narrow path holding a wicker basket and reaches up to touch the nose of a huge grey-green dragon. The dragon's horned, scaly head leans out of a cave in the cliff face, lowers and rubs gently against her cheek while she laughs with her eyes closed. A wooden walking stick lies on the path, and rocky islands sit in the grey sea below.
7416.question: What is the dragon doing?
7416.answer: It is nuzzling the woman's cheek.

7419.about: Inside a busy old-style Italian restaurant with copper pans hanging from the ceiling, a young woman in a cream silk blouse grips a huge wooden pepper mill with both hands and grinds black pepper onto a plate of pasta on a red checked tablecloth. She straightens up and lifts the mill higher and higher above her head while she keeps grinding. The young man next to her laughs and then hides his face in his hand. A waiter behind them holds another wooden pepper mill and raises his eyebrows. A water carafe and a bread basket stand on the table.
7419.question: What is the woman doing?

7420.about: On a windy green hilltop under dark storm clouds, a young woman with red hair in a long dark green dress stands barefoot and points firmly across the field while her dress blows in the wind. A black and white sheepdog drives a small group of white sheep through an open wooden gate towards the front. The sheep run past and out of sight, and the dog crouches low on the muddy grass by the gate. A quad bike, a white canvas tent and fallen metal hurdles stand on the grass behind her.

phrases.en: to lie down on the grass

7420.question: What is the woman doing?
7420.answer: She is pointing across the field.

7421.about: In a small tavern with white walls, old posters and hams hanging from a beam, a male flamenco dancer with long dark hair, a short black jacket, black trousers and heeled boots dances on a wooden stage under a spotlight. He stamps his boot so that dust flies up from the boards, then turns, swings his arms and spins with one arm raised high. A guitarist plays behind him, and the audience at small round tables with candles and wine glasses claps and cheers with open mouths.

phrases.en: to stamp on the dusty stage

7421.question: What is the dancer doing?
7421.answer: He is stamping on the dusty stage.

7422.about: In an old stone barn at dusk, lit by lanterns, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper, a leather apron and green rubber boots laughs as she pulls open the wooden tap of a big barrel. A pale golden, fizzy drink gushes out in a thick stream into a wooden tub, which fills with froth and overflows onto the floor. Crates of green pears stand nearby and bunches of pears hang from the beams. Friends at the open door to the orchard cheer, and a dog lies on the floor.

phrases.en: to tug at the wooden tap
to lie on the cobbled floor

7422.question: What is happening to the wooden tub?
7422.answer: It is overflowing with frothy perry.

7425.about: At an oil field in a dry, sunny desert, thick, shiny black crude oil pours from the valve of an old rusty red wellhead into a metal bucket. The bucket is full and overflows, and the oil runs down its sides. The black puddle with a rainbow sheen around the bucket spreads wider and wider across the cracked pale ground. A coiled hose and a pair of oily black gloves lie nearby, and in the background a pump jack, storage tanks and a whirl of dust stand in the haze.
7425.question: What is happening to the metal bucket?
7425.answer: It is overflowing with crude oil.

7427.about: In an empty old factory hall with tall arched windows, warm sunbeams shine through the dusty air. A young woman with long dark hair, a denim shirt, cream trousers and white trainers smiles with her eyes closed and her arms spread out, then turns slowly in a full circle on the dusty floor and faces the front again, still smiling. A young man in a jacket leans in the doorway and watches her. Rubble, wooden pallets and a rusty wheelbarrow lie around the hall.
7427.question: What is the woman doing?
7427.answer: She is twirling in the sunlight.

7428.about: In a dusty desert canyon with striped red and cream cliffs, a young woman with a long braid, a bandana on her head and another around her neck, a khaki vest and work gloves leans over a huge fallen log of petrified wood and presses her hands on a broken piece of it. The stone shines inside in deep red, yellow and purple. The wind blows dust, and a hat flies through the air. Her colleagues shield their eyes and watch, and a tripod and a pickup truck stand behind.

phrases.en: to touch a piece of rock

7428.question: What is the woman with gloves doing?
7428.answer: She is touching a piece of rock.

7429.about: On a windy sandy beach under a blue sky with white clouds, a young woman in a white linen shirt kneels on all fours on a red and white striped beach shelter and holds it down with her hands and knees, laughing. The wind lifts the shelter higher and higher, and she ends up lying flat on it. Loose metal tent pegs lie in the sand in front of her. Behind her a young man and woman in swimwear run and chase a flying yellow towel and a straw hat near the turquoise sea.

phrases.en: to reach for the flying towel

7429.question: What is the woman in white doing?
7429.answer: She is pinning the shelter to the sand.

7430.about: In a busy indoor fish market under a high iron roof, a young woman with a ponytail, a white T-shirt, a black waterproof apron and yellow rubber boots tosses a whole silver salmon high into the air with one hand. The salmon flies up and across the market, and a man further back catches it. Behind her another fishmonger raises both hands. White boxes of fish and mussels on ice fill the front, a tabby cat sits on a stack of crates, and older shoppers in winter coats watch.

phrases.en: to perch on a white box

7430.question: What is the ponytailed woman doing?
7430.answer: She is pitching a salmon into the air.

7434.about: At a baseball game in a thunderstorm at night, a young woman in a muddy pinstriped uniform slides head first through a brown puddle and reaches for home plate, a white five-sided slab lying in the mud. Mud splashes around her as she lands on the plate, and she lifts her head and screams with joy. A catcher in a helmet reaches out with a glove, and an umpire in navy spreads his arms wide behind them. Floodlights shine through the rain, lightning flashes, and a crowd fills the stand.
7434.question: What is the woman in stripes doing?
7434.answer: She is sliding through the mud.

7439.about: In an elegant sitting room at night with a big stone fireplace, a young man in a black dinner suit crouches on the stone floor and pushes a long metal poker into the fire. A huge burst of flame and orange sparks shoots up. He stands up and walks away from the fireplace, holding the poker with its tip still burning. Behind him guests in evening dresses and dinner jackets sit on sofas and watch. Logs, a hearth brush, tongs and a coal bucket lie on the floor.
7439.question: What is the young man doing?
7439.answer: He is stoking the fire with a poker.

7440.about: On a snowy Arctic plain at golden hour, a big white polar bear stands up on its hind legs beside a large white tundra bus with huge tyres and rests its front paws on the side under a window. Inside, a young woman in a cream knitted hat presses her hands to the glass and gasps. The bear drops down onto all four paws and walks along the bus through the snow. Other passengers look out of the windows, one covering her mouth, and a second polar bear stands in the snow in the distance.

phrases.target: the woman in the cream hat

7440.question: What is the big polar bear doing?
7440.answer: It is walking alongside the bus.

7442.about: A herd of horses runs through a shallow river in a red desert canyon. At the front a laughing young woman with a long black braid, in a denim shirt and jeans, rides barefoot and bareback on a buckskin horse straight towards the front, water splashing up around its legs. Dozens of brown, grey and white horses gallop behind her, kicking up dust and water in the golden evening light. People stand at a wooden corral fence in the background under a huge sandstone rock.
7442.question: What is the young woman doing?
7442.answer: She is riding a pony through the river.

7444.about: Inside a home garage in the evening, with the roller door open, a young woman with her hair in a messy bun, a white vest and oil-stained overalls lies on a low wheeled board under an old motorbike. She rolls out from under it, sits up under a work lamp and holds up a small part, smiling. An older man with grey hair and a moustache in a checked shirt leans down into view beside her and looks at the part. Tools hang on a wall board and a black tool chest stands behind.
7444.question: What is the woman doing?
7444.answer: She is lying under a motorbike.

7449.about: At a muddy music festival at sunset, a young woman with red braids, in a denim jacket, a floral dress and rubber boots, steps away from a makeshift toilet with her arms flung up in triumph and a pained face. Then she turns, bends her knees and pulls a pained face again. The white toilet stands behind her between hay bales and a shower curtain, with a roll of paper on a stick. A line of laughing young people in boots waits and watches, and tents and flags fill the field behind.
7449.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?
7449.answer: She is making a pained face.

7454.about: On a high mountain pass in a snowstorm, a man in a black cycling helmet and black kit rides a racing bike up a snow-covered road towards the front, his face set and his breath steaming, snowflakes stuck to his clothes. He keeps pedalling hard and comes closer. Behind him a group of cyclists wrapped in silver foil blankets stand outside a small stone hut and watch, and a marmot sits on a rock by the road. Dark clouds and rays of light cover the snowy peaks behind.
7454.question: What is the man in black doing?
7454.answer: He is pressing on through the snow.

7472.about: On a canal towpath on a misty morning, with an old brick bridge arching over the water, a laughing young man in a checked flannel shirt, a grey hoodie, work trousers and boots leans forward and hauls a green narrowboat along the bank with a thick rope over his shoulder. The boat moves slowly forward. Three young men in winter jackets sit on the boat roof, one raising a mug and cheering. A grey heron stands on the far bank, and a coil of rope and an iron winch lie on the path.

phrases.target: the man in the brown jacket

7472.question: What is the man in plaid pulling?
7472.answer: He is pulling a narrowboat along the canal.

7473.about: On a frosty village street on a cold winter morning, with stone cottages behind, a young woman in a knitted hat and a navy quilted jacket pushes down the long curved iron handle of an old cast-iron hand pump. A strong stream of water gushes from its spout into a metal bucket, fills it and splashes over the cobbles. A queue of villagers with buckets, metal milk churns and a wheelbarrow waits behind her, and a golden-brown dog drinks from the stone trough.
7473.question: What is the woman pumping?
7473.answer: She is pumping water into a bucket.

7476.about: By a stone fountain in a sunny town square, a smiling young man with black hair, in a cream knitted jumper and a chain necklace, holds a wooden cross of strings and makes a painted wooden puppet boy in a striped suit dance on the fountain's rim. The puppet kicks up a leg, bows towards a grey pigeon standing next to crumbs, and reaches a hand out to it while the pigeon stares at the puppet. Water sprays from the fountain, and friends and an old man watch and laugh.
7476.question: What is the pigeon staring at?
7476.answer: The pigeon is staring at the puppet.

7478.about: In a sunny old country kitchen, a plump tabby cat with a white chest and a brown leather collar with a small bell lies stretched out on a peeling white windowsill with one front paw hanging over the edge. The cat gets up, walks along the sill past a green potted plant and sits upright, looking out of the window. Tea towels and a jar of wooden spoons hang behind it, and a basket of onions, a ball of grey wool and a saucer of milk sit on the stone floor by a wooden table.
7478.question: What is the kitty doing?
7478.answer: The kitty is strolling along the windowsill.

7480.about: In a bank vault in a basement corridor lit by harsh white and red light, a man in a black uniform shirt and trousers braces his legs and pushes a huge round steel vault door shut, gripping its spoked wheel handle with both hands. At first metal shelves inside hold a sparkling diamond and small boxes, then the heavy door swings closed over them. Security guards in dark uniforms stand at the end of the corridor at first, next to a steel trolley at the foot of a staircase.
7480.question: What is the man heaving shut?
7480.answer: He is heaving the vault door shut.

7481.about: In a flooded museum hall with a leaking glass roof, where rain pours down in a stream, two monkeys in small aprons and white gloves stand on a stone pedestal and guide an ancient clay jar, hanging in a rope sling from a beam, back down onto its place until it stands on the pedestal. Another monkey climbs the rope above, one on a wooden crate holds a board and a lit torch, and one sits in the water on the marble floor. Glass cases, a stepladder, a fallen bust and coils of rope fill the hall.
7481.question: Where are the monkeys putting the jar?
7481.answer: They are putting it back on the pedestal.

7482.about: At a town square festival at sunset with bunting and balloons, a young woman in a safety harness leans out from a raised metal lift platform and gently lowers one long wooden block onto the very top of a giant stacking-block tower much taller than a person, with sawdust puffing out. She lets go, pulls back her hands and holds on to the railing, staring at the tower. A bald man in the platform watches, and below a large crowd stands tense, many with their hands at their faces.
7482.question: What is the woman doing?
7482.answer: She is lowering a block onto the tower.

7483.about: On a grass airstrip in a mountain valley in bright afternoon light, with snowy peaks and a glacier behind, a small cream and dark red single-engine plane with its propeller spinning comes in low and touches down on the grass. Its big fat wheels hit the ground and throw up bits of grass as it rolls past a windsock on a pole standing in an old tyre. The pilot sits in the cockpit, and a flock of sheep grazes in the field behind the plane.

phrases.en: to touch down on the grass

7483.question: What is the plane doing?
7483.answer: It is touching down on the grass.

7488.about: On a honeycomb in sunlight, a larger bee with a long, shiny orange-and-brown striped body stands over the wax cells, clearly bigger than all the others. A small white egg sits at the tip of her body over an empty cell. She moves slowly across the comb while a crowd of smaller worker bees with hairy brown bodies and clear wings walks around her, many facing her and touching her with their antennae. Further down, the cells glisten with golden honey.

phrases.en: to be bigger than the others

7488.question: What is the queen doing?

7492.about: From under a tin roof during a heavy tropical downpour, thick streams of rain pour off the roof edge and pound onto a muddy street full of brown puddles. Water gushes from a pipe and splashes onto the muddy ground right beside an old rusty oil drum. The rain keeps falling across the street, where bicycles lean against a wall under a sagging cloth awning, stacked plastic crates are covered with plastic sheeting, and banana trees stand in the grey mist.
7492.question: What is pouring off the roof?
7492.answer: Heavy rain is pouring off the tin roof.

7502.about: Inside a small boxing hall packed with spectators on wooden benches, two young boxers in white vests, one with brown gloves and one with black gloves, stand face to face. A referee in a white shirt, black bow tie and black trousers stands between them, pushes them apart with both hands, and they move out of sight. He stands alone in the middle of the ring with both arms stretched straight out to the sides and looks around sternly. White ropes run across the ring, and lamps hang over the crowd.
7502.question: What is the referee doing?
7502.answer: He is separating the two boxers.

7529.about: At a sailing race on a rough grey sea with white-capped waves, a racing yacht heels hard as it turns tightly around a huge orange inflatable buoy, passing right beside it. A young woman in a red sailing jacket and black waterproof trousers leans out over the edge of the deck holding a rope, with more crew in red behind her. The yacht sweeps past the buoy, and spray bursts up along its side. Other yachts with white sails race in the distance.

phrases.en: to bob on the rough sea

7529.question: What is the yacht doing?
7529.answer: It is rounding a huge buoy.

7738.about: A scene from the Ice Age, seen from inside a rocky cave mouth. A young woman and a young man in thick fur clothes and fur boots walk through deep snow towards the front, pulling a wooden sledge loaded with sticks, and the man smiles. A woolly mammoth with long curved tusks stomps along the frozen river behind them. A fire burns in the cave, an animal hide is stretched on a wooden rack, a hide tent stands on the shore, and huge blue glaciers rise under a cloudy golden sky.
7738.question: What is the woman doing?

7740.about: On a farm field at sunset, a big green tractor pulls a plough through the stubble, raising a cloud of dust and turning the soil into dark furrows. A young woman in a blue jacket sits in the cab. In front, a young man in a white T-shirt and orange trousers walks over the ploughed earth, looking at a handful of soil, and walks out of sight. A hawk on a wooden fence post spreads its wings and flies off over the field. Tall trees stand against an orange evening sky.
7740.question: What is the man doing?
7740.answer: He is examining a handful of soil.

7741.about: In an entrance hall with dark green walls and a patterned tiled floor, a young woman in a lilac bathrobe, a towel wrapped around her head and black high heels stands in front of the closed front door. The door swings open, and three smartly dressed young people stand on the step holding sunflowers, a cake and a wrapped present. A black and white dog runs in ahead of them. The woman jumps back in surprise, laughing, with a hand on her head, and autumn leaves blow in.

phrases.target: the man in the orange jacket

7741.question: What is the woman in lilac doing?
7741.answer: She is jumping back in surprise.

7742.about: Inside an indoor climbing hall, a young woman in a green top and black shorts leaps off the wall with one arm stretched up and grabs the big yellow hold at the very top of the steep grey climbing wall, chalk dust puffing from her hand. She hangs from it with her legs swinging. On the blue padded floor below, three friends in sports clothes watch, then throw their arms up and cheer. More climbers stand near a counter, and colourful holds cover the walls under a high roof.

phrases.en: to dangle from a yellow hold
to clutch his head in disbelief
phrases.target: the man in the navy T-shirt

phrases.en: to crouch on the blue mat
phrases.target: the man in the white vest

7742.question: What is the climber doing?
7742.answer: She is dangling from a yellow hold.

7743.about: On a seaside promenade on a stormy day, four very different young people walk along the wet paving in a row, and the strong wind blows all of them in the same way: a man in a cream suit, a young man in a black wetsuit carrying a white surfboard, a cook in a white hat and blue apron who holds her hat, and a woman in a lilac top. Their hair flies sideways and yellow leaves swirl around them. Waves crash behind the blue railing and a gull hangs in the grey sky.
7743.question: What is the cook doing?
7743.answer: She is clutching her chef's hat.

7746.about: In a dark wood-panelled bistro in the evening, a young woman in a white satin dress and a young man in a cream suit sit at a small marble table, lean their heads together and laugh. Together they cut a small white cake decorated with sugar roses with one knife and then lift the knife up, smiling at each other. Glasses of sparkling wine, a candle, a vase of pink roses, a wrapped gift and a bunch of dried flowers stand on the table, and a rainy street glows through the window.
7746.question: What are they cutting?
7746.answer: They are cutting a white cake.

7747.about: A small wooden drawbridge over a city canal is raised and split in the middle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket stands on one half and a young man in a navy jacket stands on the other half. Holding the white railings, they lean out over the gap of dark water and stretch their hands towards each other, laughing, but their fingers do not meet. Chains hang from the white beams above, a houseboat with plants is moored below, a bird flies past, and brick houses and autumn trees line the canal under grey clouds.

phrases.en: to wear a dark blue jacket

7747.question: Can their hands touch?
7747.answer: No, they are too far apart.

7749.about: A bright art studio with white brick walls and paint-splashed windows. A young woman in paint-covered white trousers and a rust-coloured top throws a huge wave of blue paint from a tin onto a big canvas full of orange and pink swirls, and the paint runs down onto the floor. She laughs and throws her head back. A young man in a paint-spotted T-shirt paints the top of the canvas from a stepladder, and other young people stand at easels in the back with a plaster bust and tables of paint.

phrases.en: to fling paint at the canvas

7749.question: What is the woman in front doing?
7749.answer: She is flinging paint at the canvas.

7750.about: A pit stop on a race track at dusk. A blue single-seat race car stands on a jack in the pit lane while a crew in blue overalls works on it at top speed. A young woman in a white top throws an old tyre through the air, picks up a new wheel and pushes it onto the front of the car as the view moves in close. A young man crouches at another wheel, and a crew member behind the car holds up a round sign. Air hoses hang from a metal boom, and an empty grandstand stands in the distance.
7750.question: What is the woman in front doing?

7752.about: An airport arrivals hall at night. A young man in a navy jacket walks in pulling a black suitcase. A young woman in a cream jumper and jeans runs to him, leaps into his arms and hugs him tightly, holding a bunch of pink and yellow tulips, while his suitcase falls over. On the stone floor lie the signs of a long wait: a stack of empty paper coffee cups, a half-eaten sandwich, a crumpled coat and a neck pillow. A porter pushes luggage trolleys past the sliding doors behind.
7752.question: What is the woman doing?
7752.answer: She is jumping into his arms.

7753.about: A restaurant kitchen seen from the doorway, through a pair of wooden swing doors with a cloth hanging over one. A young woman chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, places food on plates next to a pan of vegetables over a blue gas flame. Behind her a young man in a black apron chops greens. The viewer's hands push on the swing doors, and the chef turns towards the door and holds up her palm. Copper pans hang from a rail, lamps glow over the pass and white tiles cover the walls.

phrases.en: to put food on a plate

7753.question: What is the woman doing?
7753.answer: She is putting food on a plate.

7754.about: A one-man band on a cobbled old-town square on a sunny day. A young man in a cap and maroon shirt plays an acoustic guitar and blows a harmonica held in a holder at his mouth, with a cymbal and a drum strapped to his back and a tambourine tied to one foot. A young woman with a bicycle bends down to his open guitar case, then stands up and sings along, smiling. A small scruffy dog sits by the case, and pastel houses and a stone fountain stand behind.

phrases.en: to put money in the case
to sit next to the case

7754.question: What is the man doing?

7755.about: A work meeting in a bright office with brick walls and tall windows. A young woman in a bright blue blazer and cream trousers stands at the head of a long wooden table, raises a pen and smiles, then sits down and draws on large building plans unrolled on the table. A young man in a denim shirt and a young woman in a lilac cardigan lean over the plans with her. Open notebooks, paper cups and a glass water jug stand around them under black wire pendant lamps.

phrases.target: the woman in the blue blazer
the woman in the lilac cardigan

7755.question: What is the woman in blue doing?
7755.answer: She is sketching on the building plans.

7757.about: A young man in a white T-shirt, blue shorts and sandals waters a small vegetable garden with a hose on a sunny day, holding up a bunch of ripe red tomatoes from a plant. Behind the wooden garden fence, filling the whole background, a gigantic white cruise ship with a name on its hull glides past on the water, smoke rising from its funnel. The man looks up and speaks, then keeps watering. A deckchair, a metal watering can and pots of herbs stand on the brick path.
7757.question: What is the man doing?
7757.answer: He is spraying the tomato plants with a hose.
